doc.brief: The QGraphicsScale class provides a scale transformation.

QGraphicsScale(QObject *parent).brief: Constructs an empty QGraphicsScale object with the given *parent*.

QVector3D origin() const.brief: This property holds the origin of the scale in 3D space.

qreal xScale() const.brief: This property holds the horizontal scale factor.

qreal yScale() const.brief: This property holds the vertical scale factor.

qreal zScale() const.brief: This property holds the depth scale factor.

void originChanged().brief: [QGraphicsScale](xref:qt:QGraphicsScale) emits this signal when its origin changes.

void scaleChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the [xScale](xref:qt:QGraphicsScale), [yScale](xref:qt:QGraphicsScale), or [zScale](xref:qt:QGraphicsScale) of the object changes.

void setOrigin(const QVector3D &point).brief: This property holds the origin of the scale in 3D space.

void setXScale(qreal).brief: This property holds the horizontal scale factor.

void setYScale(qreal).brief: This property holds the vertical scale factor.

void setZScale(qreal).brief: This property holds the depth scale factor.

void xScaleChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the [xScale](xref:qt:QGraphicsScale) property changes.

void yScaleChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the [yScale](xref:qt:QGraphicsScale) property changes.

void zScaleChanged().brief: This signal is emitted whenever the [zScale](xref:qt:QGraphicsScale) property changes.

origin.brief: The origin of the scale in 3D space
